title: aster tataricus
intro: Aster tataricus, commonly known as Huangqi or Atractylodes, is a type of plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae) and is native to China. The health benefits of Aster tataricus include its use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and bloating, as well as its potential to lower blood sugar levels and cholesterol. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Aster tataricus include sesquiterpene lactones, such as atractylodin and atractyligenin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
